boss.state: Image_1 is the original illustration. Image_2 is the edited illustration. Judge whether the edited person has become an unmistakable climactic video-game antagonist, from visible design of the character alone.

boss_distinction.instructions: Score Final Boss distinction from 0 to 1. 0 means no discernible boss character. 0.25 means ordinary clothing, generic armor, or a stern face alone. 0.50 means a credible elite warrior or rival, with some boss cues. 0.75 means a distinctive endgame antagonist with a recognizable, purposeful silhouette and signature character details. 1.0 means a visually unmistakable final encounter character. Reward commanding presence built into the character design. Judge the outfit, silhouette, headpiece, insignia, and other visible evidence. Ignore scene, lighting, crop, and image polish.

repeat.state: Compare the central character designs in these two illustrations from the same visual style.

repeat.instructions: How much is the same underlying boss design repeated across the characters? Consider the silhouette, body construction, head or mask, costume shapes and signature visual idea together. Different people can be put in essentially the same boss design. Distinct bosses can both wear armor: look for individual design ideas. Differences in setting, lighting, hue, camera or pose alone say little about the design. Ignore beauty and rendering damage; those are judged separately.
criteria: Clearly different character designs with different signature forms
Mostly different designs with a few shared motifs
Related designs with substantial overlap and individual differences
Mostly the same boss template with minor design differences
Effectively the same character design or a repeat of the same illustration
